title: "Rose: RAG over a memoir"
description: "Question answering over a personal memoir with hybrid search, reranking and a knowledge graph."
categories: [RAG, Knowledge graphs, LLMs]

**Code:** [ZacharyCosenza/project-rose](https://github.com/ZacharyCosenza/project-rose)

## What it does

You ask a question about a personal memoir; Rose retrieves the relevant passages and answers with sources.

## Retrieval pipeline

```
question
  → hybrid search: 75% semantic (MiniLM embeddings) + 25% BM25 → top 25 chunks
  → cross-encoder rerank → top 12 chunks
  → knowledge-graph augmentation → up to 15 relevant (subject, predicate, object) triples
  → LLM answer (Llama 3.3 70B on Groq) with source references
```

## Building the index and the graph

- Each chunk is **contextualized by an LLM** before embedding, so short lines like "He moved there in
  1952" carry who and where.
- An LLM extracts triples per chunk. They're then hard-filtered against a fixed list of 26 predicates and
  per-predicate type rules (for example, kinship must be person → person), and self-references are dropped.
- Entities are deduplicated by embedding each one with its **predicate signature** rather than the
  surrounding text. That stops entities that merely co-occur from being merged.

## Evaluation

On a 30-question evaluation set with the knowledge graph enabled, Rose answered **63%** correctly overall:
80% of easy questions, 55% of medium and 55% of hard.
